description: Private DNS load test runs next to what the control plane, broker and serving fleet did while they ran. Click a run in the table to narrow the dashboard to it, or open the run comparison.

panels.description: One row per run in the time range. Click a run to narrow the dashboard to its window, or to compare it with another run. Publish columns are the time from the write request to the first answer from the VPC resolver; query columns cover the whole run.

targets.expr: sum by (run, scenario, commit) (count_over_time(idns_perf_publish_missed{run=~"$run"}[$__range])) or (max by (run, scenario, commit) (max_over_time(idns_perf_publish_lag_ms{run=~"$run"}[$__range])) * 0)

panels.description: For each run and step: how many answers were seen, the spread of time from write request to first answer, changes never answered, and how long the project API took to accept the write. Answers are counted per resolver, so one change watched at two resolvers counts twice.

targets.expr: sum by (run, step) (count_over_time(idns_perf_publish_missed{run=~"$run"}[$__range])) or (max by (run, step) (max_over_time(idns_perf_publish_lag_ms{run=~"$run"}[$__range])) * 0)

panels.description: What the resolvers sent back, by tier. NXDOMAIN is expected for names outside a project. SERVFAIL means a backend failed or did not answer in time. A query can pass through more than one tier.
panels.title: Answers by response code

panels.description: Histogram estimates for answered UDP frontend queries, by cluster and tier. Buckets end at 1, 10, 50, 100 and 1000 ms, then +Inf. Interpolation can show 0.5 ms without measuring that exact latency; a quantile in +Inf is capped at 1000 ms, not a measured one-second answer. Includes UDP error responses, readiness and background traffic; excludes TCP frontend answers and unanswered queries. The histogram has no response-code label: use Answers by response code separately. At low volume, one or two tail answers can move p99 sharply; compare the UDP band shares and counts below.
panels.title: UDP answer time (estimated p50 and p99)

panels.description: CPU each serving pod used, by container: dnsdist (the resolver front), serving (CoreDNS), agent (receives and activates configuration) and recursor (public recursion).
panels.title: Serving CPU by container, cores

panels.description: Working set memory of each serving pod, by container.
panels.title: Serving memory by container

panels.description: Shares from measured histogram bucket counts, without quantile interpolation: under 1 ms, over 100 ms and over 1 s. Thresholds overlap: over 1 s is a subset of over 100 ms; the lines do not sum to 100%. The denominator is the same UDP histogram population, including error and background answers, not all-protocol queries. Empty when no UDP answers were observed; missing telemetry stays empty.

targets.expr: (clamp_min((sum by (cluster, internal_dns_datum_net_tier) (increase(dnsdist_latency_count{container="dnsdist",namespace=~"ns-.*",cluster=~"$cluster",pod=~"internal-dns-.*",pod=~"(${member:regex})-[a-z0-9]+-[a-z0-9]+"}[$__rate_interval]))) - (sum by (cluster, internal_dns_datum_net_tier) (increase(dnsdist_latency_bucket{container="dnsdist",namespace=~"ns-.*",cluster=~"$cluster",pod=~"internal-dns-.*",pod=~"(${member:regex})-[a-z0-9]+-[a-z0-9]+",le="100"}[$__rate_interval]))), 0)) / (sum by (cluster, internal_dns_datum_net_tier) (increase(dnsdist_latency_count{container="dnsdist",namespace=~"ns-.*",cluster=~"$cluster",pod=~"internal-dns-.*",pod=~"(${member:regex})-[a-z0-9]+-[a-z0-9]+"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

(clamp_min((sum by (cluster, internal_dns_datum_net_tier) (increase(dnsdist_latency_count{container="dnsdist",namespace=~"ns-.*",cluster=~"$cluster",pod=~"internal-dns-.*",pod=~"(${member:regex})-[a-z0-9]+-[a-z0-9]+"}[$__rate_interval]))) - (sum by (cluster, internal_dns_datum_net_tier) (increase(dnsdist_latency_bucket{container="dnsdist",namespace=~"ns-.*",cluster=~"$cluster",pod=~"internal-dns-.*",pod=~"(${member:regex})-[a-z0-9]+-[a-z0-9]+",le="1000"}[$__rate_interval]))), 0)) / (sum by (cluster, internal_dns_datum_net_tier) (increase(dnsdist_latency_count{container="dnsdist",namespace=~"ns-.*",cluster=~"$cluster",pod=~"internal-dns-.*",pod=~"(${member:regex})-[a-z0-9]+-[a-z0-9]+"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

panels.title: UDP answers by latency threshold, share

panels.description: Rolling counts over the same Grafana rate interval as the percentile chart: all UDP histogram answers on the right axis, over 100 ms and over 1 s on the left. Slow counts subtract finite buckets from that same population. A large p99 alongside only one or two slow answers is different from sustained high-volume latency. Counts may be fractional because increase() can extrapolate between scrapes; they are not packet-level event logs. Zero means a sampled counter did not increase, while missing telemetry stays empty. Includes error responses; see Answers by response code for their separate breakdown.
panels.title: UDP answer counts in the lookback window
